name: Adobe Sign
description: Adobe Sign is the former product name of Adobe Acrobat Sign, Adobe's electronic-signature service for agreements, reusable templates, signing workflows, reminders, audit trails, and signed documents.
agentUseSummary: Adobe's current product and developer documentation identify the service as Adobe Acrobat Sign. Relay will not create a second connection identity for the legacy Adobe Sign name; this alias remains unavailable until the canonical Adobe Acrobat Sign provider iteration is integrated.

blocked.label: Connect Adobe Sign
blocked.description: Use the canonical Adobe Acrobat Sign provider after its reviewed connector is integrated; no duplicate Adobe Sign connection is created.

blocked.label: Read signing data
blocked.description: Agreements, participants, documents, templates, workflows, widgets, audit trails, and events are unavailable through this legacy alias.

blocked.label: Change Adobe Sign
blocked.description: Sending, signing, reminding, cancelling, downloading, archiving, sharing, template, workflow, webhook, and administrative actions are unavailable through this legacy alias.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable legacy alias
approvalProfiles.description: No action is mounted under the former Adobe Sign name; canonical identity belongs to Adobe Acrobat Sign.

runtimeSupport.description: No tools are mounted under the legacy Adobe Sign alias.
No tools are mounted under the legacy Adobe Sign alias.

providerSetup.blocker: Adobe Sign is a legacy product name for Adobe Acrobat Sign, whose canonical provider iteration is separately owned. Creating a second slug with independent credentials would duplicate connection state and violate Relay's canonical-provider policy.
providerSetup.nextAction: After the canonical Adobe Acrobat Sign iteration is integrated, map searches and legacy display references for Adobe Sign to that single canonical provider without creating another connection, OAuth app, token store, or runtime tool namespace.

evidence.supports: Adobe's current developer guide names the service Acrobat Sign and documents agreements, signed documents, embedded signing, reminders, widgets, library documents, workflows, audit trails, and APIs.
Adobe's current release notes title the product Adobe Acrobat Sign and route developer updates to the Acrobat Sign developer guide.

Adobe documents Acrobat Sign OAuth access-point discovery, one-hour access tokens, refresh-token lifecycle, and revocation; those credentials must belong to the canonical provider rather than a duplicate alias.
